meta.bootstrap: paired percentile, queries resampled with replacement, shared across systems
notes: pg_textsearch resolves text_config without search_path: use 'public.kazakh_cfg', not 'kazakh_cfg'.
Two BM25 indexes on one column make the planner pick either one; use one column per config.
Selecting the BM25 score next to ORDER BY forces per-row scoring (~250x slower); rank by position.
